release: War Room OS V9.6 Causal Anti-Overfit Research Factory
principle: No formula, weight, code search or backtest is permitted before the exact market map is frozen.

us.decision_purpose: Select a small long/short set of US common stocks and REITs for monthly or filing-event horizons; shorts require contemporaneous borrow proof.
us.source_country_liquidity: US-listed securities; issuer, customer, supplier and source-country exposure are separately timestamped; liquidity is security-specific.

benchmark_target_horizon.target: net forward return distribution and implied market-cap range

interaction_conditions: bottleneck is active rather than merely possible
valuation does not already fully discount the outcome
us.claim_limits: No proof transfer from aggregate ETFs, current-only universes, revised fundamentals, narrative hindsight or technical patterns.

idx.decision_purpose: Select liquid IDX cash-equity longs; no short recommendation until legal and broker-specific short availability is proven.
idx.source_country_liquidity: Indonesia-listed cash equities with issuer-level import/export exposure; free float, negotiated crossings and daily liquidity are separately measured.

benchmark_target_horizon.target: net forward return and downside distribution

data_lineage_availability: broker summary/done detail when legally available
interaction_conditions: flow is persistent after crossing adjustment
idx.claim_limits: Current ticker lists, unadjusted broker summaries and chart structure cannot establish historical alpha.

commodity.decision_purpose: Trade exact CME/NYMEX/COMEX WTI, gold and copper contract sleeves with explicit roll and collateral policy.
commodity.source_country_liquidity: Contract and delivery-location specific; producer, consumer and transit-country exposures are mapped separately.

benchmark_target_horizon.target: contract return distribution and physical price range

interaction_conditions: inventory surprise is not revised hindsight
commodity.claim_limits: Generic continuous futures, revised inventory series and COT publication look-ahead cannot prove a contract strategy.

fx.decision_purpose: Trade exact CME EUR, JPY, GBP, AUD and CAD currency futures; no proof transfer from OTC spot.
fx.source_country_liquidity: Currency-pair and CME-contract specific; home and counter-currency liquidity and intervention regimes are mapped separately.
interaction_conditions: relative rather than absolute macro gap
fx.claim_limits: Final revised macro data, generic USD factors and OTC spot fills cannot establish CME futures proof.

crypto.decision_purpose: Trade BTC and ETH on explicitly named Binance and Deribit spot/perpetual instruments and accounts.
crypto.source_country_liquidity: Venue, instrument and collateral specific; protocol and stablecoin issuer jurisdiction are separately recorded.
interaction_conditions: value capture accrues to the token
funding is not the sole origin
counterparty and depth limits are respected
invalidation: token not required for value capture
crypto.claim_limits: Cross-venue aggregation, current snapshots and public price history cannot prove an account-specific execution strategy.
